items.name: Matrix.det_reindex
items.type: {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype m] {R : Type v} [CommRing R] (e e' : m ≃ n) (M : Matrix m m R) : ((Matrix.reindex e e') M).det = ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign (e'.trans e.symm)) * M.det
